title: Senior Product Director, Agentification, Skills and Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. </strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>About Data & Technology Solutions</strong></p> <p>WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.</p> <p>WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realise the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster and at scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why We Are Hiring:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a technically minded product leader to define what WPP's agents are actually able to do. This is a new role, created to own the layer beneath the interface: the core set of skills and tools that agents call, the guardrails that keep them safe to use, the data and context they reason over, and the agentification of WPP's own applications so that they can be operated by an agent and not only by a person.</p> <p>The ideal candidate will have taken an established product and made it agent-native — exposing its capabilities as tools, skills and data an agent can call, defining the contracts, permissions and behaviour around them, and proving the result is reliable to put in front of enterprise customers. Skills, tools and agentification are not new in the industry, and we are looking for someone who has already done this work somewhere it mattered.</p> <p>This is a more technical product role in the Agentic Experience pillar and sits at the intersection of product and AI. You may come from product management, engineering or data science. What matters is that you can hold a clear point of view on where a capability belongs — in the model, in a tool, in the data, or in the interface — and defend it with evidence.</p> <p>It is also a visionary / forward-looking role in the pillar. A good deal of what you will own does not exist yet, and part of the job is deciding what should. This requires a product leader who is comfortable with ambiguity but still ships, and who can bring a large organisation along with them.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></p> <p>Within this IC role, reporting into the Senior Director Product Enablement WPP Open – you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for skills, tools and agentification across WPP Open, ensuring alignment with the broader Open strategy and business objectives.</li> <li>Define the core set of skills that WPP's agents are built from — what exists as a first-party skill, what is left to users to compose, and what should not be a skill at all.</li> <li>Own the tool layer: how WPP and third-party capabilities are exposed to agents through well-defined interfaces, contracts, permissions and connectivity standards such as MCP.</li> <li>Lead the agentification of WPP applications, working with the teams that own them to make their capabilities callable, observable and safe to operate agentically.</li> <li>Define the guardrails (what an agent may do, on whose authority, with what data), working with Agent Governance so they are built into the product.</li> <li>Own the evaluation and quality approach for skills and for chained agent output: how capability is tested before release and monitored after it.</li> <li>Define the data and context strategy that agents reason over, spanning retrieval, grounding, memory, context management and the interfaces to WPP's data and knowledge assets.</li> <li>Work closely with Engineering, Design, UX and Data to deliver a coherent skills layer. Set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.</li> <li>Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.</li> <li>Use data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from stakeholders and systems to enhance product adoption and usage continually.</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients, and make an unfamiliar technical area legible to senior stakeholders so that new capabilities are understood and adopted, and their benefits championed.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Will Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, engineering leadership or applied data science, with significant time spent on AI or platform products.</li> <li>Proven track record of taking an established SaaS or enterprise product and making it agent-native.</li> <li>Deep and current knowledge of agent architectures: LLMs, tool, skill and function calling, RAG and retrieval design, context & memory management, multi-agent orchestration, and connectivity standards such as MCP.</li> <li>Direct experience with working with agent and tooling ecosystems such as MCP/A2A servers and clients, LangChain or LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or comparable skill and tool frameworks.</li> <li>Experience defining guardrails, permissions and safety controls for autonomous or semi-autonomous systems and making them part of the product.</li> <li>Experience with evaluation of non-deterministic systems: test sets, scoring rubrics, regression testing, human review and production monitoring.</li> <li>Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability, with the ability to hold a credible technical conversation with senior engineers.</li> <li>Experience with data and knowledge platforms — retrieval, embeddings, semantic search, taxonomy and grounding against enterprise content.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</strong></p> <p><strong>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</strong></p> <h4><strong>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment">https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</strong></h4></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Money is DoorDash’s organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.</p> <p>You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.</p> <h2>You're excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Drive Money Domain’s Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain’s strategy into executable technical programs. </li> <li>Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.</li> <li>Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Money Domain (Financial Systems). You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end consumer, rider/ courier, and merchant experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.</li> <li>Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.</li> <li>Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. </li> </ul> <h2>We're excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You’re experienced in working with engineering teams on  large-scale distributed systems and/or b2b products. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs.</li> <li>You’re a strong leader with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.</li> <li>You have strong ownership, urgency, and drive. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to understand and drive your programs.</li> <li>You have excellent written & verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. You can convey concepts and considerations to non-experts and experts alike.</li> <li>You’ve engaged with Engineering teams on product & platform development with a thorough understanding of software development processes and project planning.</li> <li>You are pragmatic and detailed in your approach and focus on progress, not perfection.</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s Degree with experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline.</li> <li>5+ years recent experience as a Technical Programme Manager at a technology/ FinTech company, in Financial Systems.</li> <li>Experience with regulatory compliance in Financial Systems, e.g. SOX, PSD2, or equivalent would be an advantage.</li> <li>Experience in large-scale distributed systems and system architecture.</li> <li>Experience working directly with engineering teams on product development, with a thorough understanding of software development processes, system architecture, and scalability trade-offs.</li> <li>Project planning and execution skills that include reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Our Risk & Compliance practice is looking for an experienced Director to help shape and grow our Economic Crime capability.</span></h3> <p>Baringa is committed to reducing economic crime and the negative consequences it has on society. We help clients understand how economic crime can be carried out through their organisations and put in place targeted, proportionate controls that manage risk effectively while supporting sustainable growth and positive customer outcomes.</p> <p>As a Director, you will combine deep Economic crime expertise with senior client leadership, commercial development and practice building. Reporting to the VP of Data and sitting on the Data Leadership Team, you lead the analysis, architecture, design and development of our Data and Analytics estate. Experience designing data products across source-aligned, aggregate and consumer-aligned patterns. Proven ability to architect and scale modern cloud data platforms using Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Amazon Redshift, and S3. Hands-on expertise in developing robust data transformation pipelines and orchestrating complex workflows using dbt and Apache Airflow. Strong track record of automating infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform and GitHub Actions. Ability to implement data governance, technical catalogues, end-to-end lineage, and data product portals to maximise data observability. Experience leveraging AI tooling to accelerate data engineering workflows, migrations, and platform readiness for AI applications. Experience establishing or leading a community of practice, driving standards adoption across teams. Proven track record of cross-functional partnership with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Governance teams. Act as a technical bridge and mentor, training "builders" across the company to move from basic AI usage to sophisticated system creation. title: Product Engineer (Backend)
description: Hey! We're team Granola 👋 We're building a category-defining product, backed by a $125M Series C and used daily by teams at companies like Cursor, Vanta, and Linear. We started by making meeting notes better. Now we're turning every conversation a company has into context that people and agents can act on: shared team workspaces, APIs and integrations, and agentic workflows that do something with what was said. If you haven't already, you should check out what we're building , and why you should work here . The role You'll own the systems that make Granola fast, accurate and trustworthy for the next 100x of users, and you'll help decide what's worth building. Our backend engineers talk to users and ship product, not just services. What you'll work on The voice pipeline. Scale real-time transcription so notes land accurately in seconds, on every device people use. New models in production. Evaluate new voice and transcription models as they're released, and get the best ones into users' hands. The agent harness. Build the harness Granola's agents run in: long-running jobs, tool calls, retries, and retrieving the right context. APIs and integrations. Extend the APIs and integrations that let people bring Granola context into the AI tools they already use. Enterprise-grade trust. Build the permissions, data isolation and admin controls that let a company roll Granola out across every team. Data at scale. Own Postgres performance, observability and alerting as usage grows. How we work People and product first. We hire people who are kind, down to earth and pragmatic, who care deeply about the product, and who want to stay connected to the customers using it. Product isn't one team's job here; it's everyone's. High autonomy. Engineers spot opportunities and ship improvements themselves. We’d rather you ship it than write about it. Everyone talks to users. Every engineer works directly with the people using Granola, and that's where most of our best ideas come from. A high bar for engineering and product. We expect strong technical ability and strong product sense. Engineers think like PMs: they understand the user's problem and help shape the direction of what they build. Room to experiment. Every engineer has a budget from day one to use new models, tools and technologies which make them more productive. Design and quality matter. Thoughtful design, a high quality bar and close collaboration on everything we build. We work in person, with flexibility. We’re in the office five days a week because we genuinely like building together. It’s relaxed: dress down, bring your dog, and no fixed office hours. What that looks like in practice: the version of Granola we use internally goes far beyond the public app. We're building at the frontier of agentic software, and we try every new capability on ourselves first. The team The Granola team is kind, curious and design-obsessed. Many of us are former founders, others have built products at Figma, Apple, Google and Meta, and we're all still learning from each other. Who we're looking for We don't set a minimum number of years. Some of our strongest engineers graduated two years ago; others have run their own companies. We care about what you've built and how you think about it. You've owned backend systems in production that real users depended on, and you can talk through the trade-offs you made. You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js. You know relational databases deeply (we use Postgres): query plans, indexing, and migrations without downtime. You're comfortable with cloud infrastructure as code (we use AWS, Terraform and a lot of Lambda). You think about security and failure modes before the happy path. You have product sense: you can explain why a system matters to the person using it, and you'd rather ship what users need this week than the perfect version next quarter. Bonus: experience with speech or audio pipelines, LLM infrastructure, evals, or streaming systems. Our stack TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, AWS (with plenty of Lambda), Terraform, plus whichever new models and tools prove themselves. You don't need experience with everything, but you should be excited to work close to the product and at real scale. How we hire Our interviews start with the product: who the user is, what problem matters and what you'd build first. Throughout, we're looking for product sense, good judgement on trade-offs, real engineering depth, and how you'd use your experience to shape a product from the ground up. We also look for people who ship quickly, iterate and love to experiment, and who stay kind and pragmatic along the way. What we offer We're living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968, and we want to build that future together in London. We pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity. We work together in person five days a week at our office in Old Street, and we offer relocation support if you're moving to London. Great people come from all kinds of backgrounds. If this speaks to you, whether or not you look like a fit on paper, we'd love to hear from you. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role. You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success. This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on. What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers. Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency. Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned). High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures. Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success. Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints. Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities. Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta. Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement. How to be successful in this role: Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday). Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, GRC consultant, or equivalent customer-facing role, including previous B2B SaaS experience. Strategic Problem Solver: Possess deep technical proficiency to identify and validate technical, operational, and business pain points, driving clarity on solution requirements (Viable Solution Win). Exceptional Communicator: Exhibit outstanding communication, storytelling, and active listening abilities, capable of delivering tailored, high-impact demonstrations that reinforce the sales narrative (Command of the Message). Customer-Centric Advocate: Lead with empathy and curiosity, focusing on strategic discovery to uncover the why and urgency behind customer needs and tying every technical detail to measurable buyer impact (Desirable Solution Win). Collaborative Deal Shaper: Work in lockstep with Account Executives on deal strategy, proactively strengthening qualification and guiding stakeholders toward alignment on a clear delivery path (Aligned Solution Win). Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture. Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills. Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills. Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus. Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space. Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. Role Overview Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective. Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area. Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations. What You'll Do Engage with lawyers at existing and prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges, and then explain and demonstrate the value of Harvey’s AI solutions to address them. Establish yourself as a credible expert in solving customers’ specific legal problems (e.g. researching public and private databases for certain types of information, drafting and analyzing contractual provisions and whole documents, analyzing briefs and filings, corporate governance, conducting due diligence). Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases. Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types. Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens. Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs. Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs. Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors. Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices. What You Have Must be qualified to practice law in England & Wales, with at least 3 years of experience practicing law at a top-tier law firm in the U.K. Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals. Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry. Sales or customer-facing experience, including law firm business development and/or secondment, is a plus, as is experience directly managing law firm client matters and client relationships. title: Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start - Manchester
description: <p><strong>Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start – Manchester</strong></p> <p><strong>Manchester, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including<br>accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants work together to solve complex safety and security challenges, helping our clients protect what matters most. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we continue toadvance the science of safety and make a meaningful difference to the communities we serve.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives, skills and talents they bring to our organisation.</p> <p>Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?</p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Fire Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.</p> <p>These roles are open across our UK & Ireland offices. Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.</p> <p><strong><em>Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland.</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career?</strong></p> <p><strong>Your career can go further than you think.</strong> 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.</p> <p><strong>Be part of a leading fire consultancy.</strong> We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.</p> <p><strong>Learn from experienced engineers.</strong> As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.</p> <p><strong>Build your career in a supportive environment.</strong> You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.</p> <p><strong>Take responsibility early.</strong> You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.</p> <p><strong>What will you be working on?</strong></p> <p>As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.</p> <p>Your work will include:</p> <ul> <li>Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a<br>range of new and existing building projects.</li> <li>Working across a diverse range of buildings,<br>including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport<br>developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.</li> <li>Analysing fire growth, means of escape,<br>structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,<br>including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.</li> <li>Preparing technical reports and liaising with<br>clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <p>To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:</p> <ul> <li>Right to work in the UK or Ireland.</li> <li>A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two<br>years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,<br>Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication<br>skills in English.</li> <li>Additional qualifications and experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>The following would also help you succeed in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A team player who can work effectively with<br>colleagues at all levels.</li> <li>Excellent communication and time management<br>skills.</li> <li>Enthusiasm to innovate.</li> <li>A second European language is an advantage but<br>not essential.</li> </ul> <p>We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.</p> <p>If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Graduate Development Programme</strong></p> <p>Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.</p> <p>Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake <strong>Continuing Professional Development (CPD)</strong> as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards <strong>Chartered Engineer status</strong>, helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Sustainability in Fire Engineering</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.</p> <p>In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.</p> <p><strong>Our People Are Our Greatest Asset</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.</p> <p><strong>Our UK&I Benefits Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Private medical insurance</li> <li>33 days of holiday(including<br>bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years</li> <li>Industry-leading contributory pension scheme</li> <li>4x life assurance</li> <li>Income protection scheme</li> <li>Discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee assistance programme</li> <li>Enhanced parental-related pay</li> <li>Recognition and reward programmers to celebrate<br>team efforts</li> <li>Access to extensive technical training and<br>resources</li> </ul> <p><strong>Supporting Your Work-Life Balance:</strong></p> <p>We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and patterns</li> <li>Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year</li> <li>Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years</li> <li>The option to carry over up to five unused<br>holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval)</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Commitment to Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <p>Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.</p> <p>#LI-JC1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p> </p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.  Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all rele

release gates and regression detection for production deployments, owning readiness calls and incident follow-through Stay hands-on in the data and code when needed (Python/C++/SQL) to accelerate end-to-end learned driving system with no existing playbook to copy External-facing performance reporting that's trusted and repeatable enough to share directly with partners like Uber Integrating new model features and architectures from core engineering into live Robotaxi operations The stack underneath it all: WayveCode (Python + C++), Looker, Databricks/SQL, Grafana, and internal evaluation and sim tooling In your first 90 days: mapping the top prioritised fixes across backend, robot, and driving model, and shipping a new driving model deployment and robot software release end-to-end 👤 You autonomy/robotics performance debugging experience, including deep hands-on work with real-world issues and time-series/real-time signals, rather than just managing a queue You have strong technical title: Management Consulting, Head of AI and Technology
description: <h2>Role purpose</h2> <p>The Head of AI and Technology is accountable for the direction, delivery and adoption of AI across Teneo Management Consulting and for ensuring that its broader technology environment supports the needs of the business. The role sets the AI strategy and investment priorities, leads the AI Engineering team, owns the strategy and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data, knowledge-management workflows and subscriptions, and acts as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT on centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</p> <p>The role connects Management Consulting's priorities with Teneo's central AI team, Teneo IT and other control and enabling functions. It translates business needs into Management Consulting-owned AI and technology initiatives or clear requirements for central teams, moves high-value AI and software solutions from experimentation into reliable use, and gives consultants the skills and support required to use approved AI tools effectively.</p> <p>It is primarily an internal capability role. The role is accountable for the allocation and utilisation of the AI Engineering team, including support for selected client engagements, and for the Management Consulting-specific AI and broader technology within its remit. Teneo IT and Teneo's central AI team remain accountable for the centrally managed services and capabilities, while Management Consulting engagement leaders retain accountability for client relationships, overall engagement delivery and revenue targets.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <h3>AI strategy and priorities</h3> <ul> <li>Own the Management Consulting AI strategy, roadmap and priorities, aligned with the business strategy and Teneo-wide AI direction. Consult Teneo's central AI team on new solutions to reuse firm-wide capabilities, avoid duplication and manage enterprise dependencies.</li> <li>Identify and assess AI opportunities across consulting delivery, business development, proposition development, internal operations and knowledge work.</li> <li>Own prioritisation of AI opportunities and allocation of AI Engineering capacity within the approved budget, considering value, feasibility, risk, reuse potential, capacity and cost. Escalate material investments, major reprioritisation and strategically sensitive work to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Develop business cases and recommend whether Management Consulting should build, buy, partner, reuse a central capability, scale an existing initiative or stop further investment.</li> <li>Define outcome measures for priority AI initiatives and report progress, realised value, adoption, spend, risks and dependencies to Management Consulting and wider Teneo leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>Leadership of the AI Engineering team</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the day-to-day work of the Management Consulting AI Engineering team, including objectives, prioritisation, resource allocation, workforce planning, utilisation, delivery oversight and performance management.</li> <li>Balance the team's capacity across client engagements, internal tooling development, enablement of the broader MC team, and technical capability improvement, while maintaining sustainable workloads.</li> <li>Set and enforce engineering and product standards for Management Consulting AI solutions, consistent with mandatory Teneo-wide architecture, AI, security and technology standards.</li> <li>Define clear demand, resourcing and decision-making processes between the AI Engineering team and key stakeholders, including Resourcing, Operations, Finance, project leads and the wider client-facing team.</li> <li>Build the team's capability through recruitment, coaching, feedback, career development and targeted use of external partners where justified.</li> <li>Maintain high practical AI fluency and sufficient technical understanding to create simple prototypes, automations and demonstrations, evaluate their outputs and translate business needs into clear engineering requirements, without becoming the bottleneck for implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>AI service lifecycle</h3> <ul> <li>Oversee the path from discovery and prototyping to production, adoption, support and retirement for Management Consulting AI solutions.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are designed for reuse where appropriate and integrate with approved data, identity, security and collaboration environments.</li> <li>Establish proportionate evaluation and monitoring for quality, reliability, user experience, cost and risk, including controls for generative AI outputs.</li> <li>Define ownership and support arrangements before launch, and ensure that technical debt, maintenance and business continuity inform investment and prioritisation decisions.</li> </ul> <h3>Business partnership and consulting integration</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with Management Consulting leadership and practice leads to translate business priorities into a focused AI agenda and secure decisions on investment, risk and operating change.</li> <li>Support proposition and methodology development by identifying where approved AI capabilities can improve the quality, speed or differentiation of consulting work.</li> <li>Advise case teams on feasible and responsible use of AI, deploying the AI Engineering team where specialist support is justified. Own the team's allocation and utilisation; engagement leaders remain accountable for client relationships and engagement delivery.</li> <li>Represent Management Consulting in relevant Teneo forums and maintain productive relationships with external technology and delivery partners.</li> </ul> <h3>Teneo IT partnership and centrally managed technology</h3> <ul> <li>Act as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT, representing the business's needs and priorities in relation to centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</li> <li>Translate Management Consulting requirements into clear input for firm-wide technology strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions, and communicate central plans, constraints and decisions to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Coordinate with Teneo IT and relevant central functions on architecture, integration, identity and access, hosting, resilience, service support and technology changes affecting Management Consulting.</li> <li>Monitor the performance of centrally managed services within Management Consulting, escalating material issues and working with Teneo IT to agree appropriate action.</li> </ul> <h3>Management Consulting technology, knowledge management and subscriptions</h3> <ul> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data and subscriptions, aligned with business and AI priorities and Teneo-wide standards.</li> <li>Maintain a coherent view of Management Consulting applications, data sources, knowledge assets, licences and subscriptions, reducing duplication and addressing material capability gaps.</li> <li>Own selected technology-enabled knowledge-management workflows, including the capture, organisation, permissioning, retrieval and reuse of knowledge for consulting and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li>Work with client-facing teams and designated knowledge owners to establish clear accountability for the quality, permissions and appropriate use of knowledge assets, while acting as a key stakeholder in wider knowledge-management decisions.</li> <li>Lead business cases, supplier evaluation, procurement and renewals for Management Consulting-specific tools and services. Manage approved expenditure, licences and consumption within delegated authority and the relevant central approval processes.</li> </ul> <h3>Training enablement and adoption</h3> <ul> <li>Set the AI capability-building plan for Management Consulting, based on the needs of different roles, practices and levels of experience.</li> <li>Direct practical training, guidance, demonstrations, office hours and communities of practice that help colleagues apply approved tools to real consulting workflows.</li> <li>Expand the network of leaders and super-users who can reinforce good practice, surface demand and support adoption within their teams.</li> <li>Measure confidence, active use, quality and workflow impact, and adapt the enablement programme where training does not translate into sustained behaviour change.</li> <li>Maintain clear communication on available tools, expected use, limitations, new releases and routes for support.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsible AI governance and risk</h3> <ul> <li>Consult Teneo's central AI team on proposed solutions to identify existing capabilities, avoid duplication and maintain alignment with Teneo-wide AI direction.</li> <li>Work with Cyber Security, Risk, Legal and IT to translate firm-wide requirements into practical delivery and usage controls.</li> <li>Ensure new AI solutions receive the required Cyber Security and Risk approvals prior to implementation, with clear records of decisions, exceptions and accountable owners.</li> <li>Promote safe handling of client and firm information and address emerging model, vendor and regulatory risks as the technology changes.</li> </ul> <h2>Experience and capabilities</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience setting and delivering an AI and technology strategy in a professional services, consulting or similarly knowledge-intensive environment.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and taking AI or software products from discovery into secure, supported production use, with the judgement to challenge decisions on architecture, integration, evaluation, security and operational support.</li> <li>High practical AI fluency, demonstrated through regular use of generative AI tools and the ability to create and evaluate simple prototypes, automations or workflows. title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Financial Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. The Customer Success Manager will join a team of trusted partners alongside their Account Manager, working closely with newly onboarded and existing clients to demonstrate the full value of our platform, develop strong client engagement, drive successful renewals and contribute to growth across dedicated accounts. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.</p> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. culture</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The Applied AI team’s role is to be proxies title: EMEA New Business Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><strong>About Netcraft</strong></p> <p>Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.</p> <p>Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.</p> <p>That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection. </p> <p> </p></div><div id="message-list_1778797102.223239"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role </strong><br>Reporting directly to the Director of Sales and working closely with colleagues across the UK and other global teams, this role is wholly focused on winning net new corporate customers across the EMEA region.<br>This is a pure new business role. You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing high-value opportunities with net new customers, operating with a high degree of ownership across the full new business sales cycle.<br><br><strong>Why join Netcraft’s commercial team? </strong><br>You will be joining a high-performing commercial organisation with a strong track record of growth and execution. Over recent years, the team has consistently delivered against target, with:</div> <ul> <li>100%+ attainment against ARR targets across multiple years</li> <li>90%+ of fully ramped Account Executives exceeding annual targets in 2025</li> <li>60%+ year-on-year growth in New Sales ARR in 2025</li> <li>Several of the largest new business deals in company history closed in recent quarters</li> </ul> <div><strong>This is what you’ll be doing, day to day: </strong></div> <ul> <li>Driving net new business across the EMEA region and securing contracts with new corporate customers against target</li> <li>Owning the full sales cycle from initial engagement through to close</li> <li>Building and maintaining strong pipeline coverage through a combination of self-generated outbound activity and qualified inbound opportunities</li> <li>Prospecting daily through channels such as email, LinkedIn, phone, and strategic outreach</li> <li>Engaging senior stakeholders to understand business challenges and requirements, particularly in relation to cybersecurity and digital risk</li> <li>Leading commercial conversations and positioning Netcraft’s value clearly in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> <li>Drafting and delivering compelling proposals, working closely with technical teams where needed to address customer requirements</li> <li>Maintaining accurate pipeline visibility and ensuring Salesforce is updated consistently with high-quality activity and account notes</li> <li>Providing feedback and ideas on ways to shorten sales cycles, improve sales effectiveness, and strengthen Netcraft’s market positioning</li> <li>Conducting all sales activities with a high degree of professionalism, credibility, and integrity</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll need to be successfu</strong>l</div> <ul> <li>Consistent success exceeding quota in complex, long-cycle sales environments</li> <li>A strong track record of measurable achievement, ideally including top-performer recognition such as President’s Club or similar</li> <li>Significant experience in quota-carrying corporate B2B sales roles, with a strong track record of winning net new business and closing high-value deals</li> <li>Proven ability to generate pipeline independently and create opportunities through proactive outbound activity</li> <li>Strong commercial and discovery skills, with the ability to identify customer needs, build urgency, and progress opportunities effectively</li> <li>Experience selling into regulated industries and/or in cybersecurity, digital risk, fraud, SaaS, or similarly complex technical environments would be highly valuable</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently at senior and executive level</li> <li>Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills</li> <li>A high-ownership mindset, with the ability to organise, prioritise, and manage activity effectively, including customer travel where needed</li> <li>Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform</li> <li>A genuine interest in cybersecurity and the ability to build credibility quickly in a technically nuanced market</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>The Reward Package:</strong></p> <div class="ewa-rteLine"> <ul> <li>33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer</li> <li>Generous enhanced family leave and pay</li> <li>Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service</li> <li>Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings</li> <li>Private health cover, including access to a private GP service</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4 x salary</li> <li>Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success</li> <li>Hybrid and flexible working options</li> <li>Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office</li> <li>Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family</li> <li>Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career</li> <li>Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity</li> <li>Employee Referral Bonus scheme</li> <li>Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions </li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion </strong></p> <p>This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. </p> <p>We’re also happy to make adjustments to the hiring process to ensure every candidate can participate fully. </p> <p><strong>Please note:</strong> Netcraft does not accept unsolicited approaches from external recruiters. </p> <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. You work hands-on with a small, high-ownership team. You have real influence over how we build our infrastructure as we grow it together. title: Revenue Operations Manager
description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the processes, workflows, automations, and data architecture that accelerate how we find, engage, win, onboard, retain, and expand customers at scale. we procure next as we scale Cross-functional partnership and enablement Operational business partner to GTM leadership Drive systems and process adoption across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and actionable workflows Sellers and customer-facing teams spend materially less time on manual admin and prep Critical revenue systems are connected, key workflows are AI-assisted or fully automated Leadership has a real-time view into pipeline, conversion, execution, and customer health You're a great fit if you: 5+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS hypergrowth environment Deep hands-on expertise in CRM administration (HubSpot/Salesforce) Proven track record building revenue systems, processes, and data flows from scratch Persistent problem-solver at your core Sharp entrepreneurial instincts and analytical mindset Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management What you can look forward to: Taking full ownership of high-leverage systems and delivering work that directly impacts pipeline, productivity, and revenue Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up A competitive compensation and equity package that reflects the leverage and strategic importance of the role At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. title: Senior PR Manager
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. You bring strong expertise in Python and SQL to oversee the full lifecycle of a model, from initial prototype to robust production deployment.</li> <li>A decisive collaborator who can navigate technical trade-offs and translate complex ML concepts for cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Familiarity with complex data environments and model architectures, such as deep learning (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800 </p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role.
